notes: Seven distinct movable-part episodes are visible. The paired coat-closet and laundry-closet leaves are reported separately; their exact opening and reverse-order closing assignments are somewhat uncertain because the actions occur between sparsely sampled views. The final approach to the desk/piano does not show a completed state change.
scene_description: A user surveys an apartment entryway, opens and inspects a two-leaf coat closet, opens and inspects a two-leaf laundry closet, then manipulates an integrated refrigerator, an upper spice cabinet, and a lower utensil drawer in the kitchen before moving into the living area.
